_README: Site UI translations. The top-level key is the language code (see config/i18n.ts). To add a language: copy the entire 'en' block, change its key to the new code, translate the values, and add a matching entry in config/i18n.ts. Keys missing from a language fall back to English automatically. Dynamic placeholders: {name} = SITE.fullName, {origin} = SITE.origin, {siteName} = SITE.name, {role} = SITE.title, {age} = computed age from BIRTH_DATE. Brand names and proper nouns are intentionally left untranslated.
